subject: COM
label: Grade 03
task: Meet the outcome of every unit in Grade 03 Computing, and keep one piece of evidence for each.
condition: A 36-week school year, 4 units, a teacher or guide, a learning book or device, and local examples in the local language first with English support.
standard: Each unit: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school. Course pass: no unit at 'Not yet' after one retry, and a pass in SA1 and SA2.

modules.title: Pictures and shapes in a drawing program
modules.outcome: rotate, resize, colour and save a picture
modules.intro: In this unit you work on 'Pictures and shapes in a drawing program', taught in a way that is short, playful, with objects, pictures and talk. The target is clear: rotate, resize, colour and save a picture. You move from seeing it, to saying it, to doing it alone.
points: See it: watch or try the skill in 'Pictures and shapes in a drawing program' on a teacher screen or a safe device.
Name the parts: write the key words and what each part does.
Use it: rotate, resize, colour and save a picture. Save your work in a named file or folder.
Test and fix: run it, find one fault, correct it, and note what you changed.
modules.example: Solved: Draw a square, put a triangle on top, add a door and fill with colour: a house. Save as house.png. Method: Model run for 'Pictures and shapes in a drawing program'. Goal in one sentence. Plan: list the steps in order before touching the device. Do: follow the plan, saving after each step. Test: try normal input and one unusual input. Fix: change one thing and test again. Share: show a partner and explain it. What a good answer looks like: it works for normal input, steps match the plan, and the learner can explain each part. Online safety rules apply at all times.
modules.activity: About 20 to 30 minutes of class work, then one short practice task for home. Keep evidence: one page in your learning book.
modules.standard: Rotate, resize, colour and save a picture: at least 4 of 5 attempts correct, said or written, with one real example from home or school.

L2: create documents; follow simple instructions in blocks.
